title: Osiris catacombs
summary: These galleries contained niches for small Osiris figures rather than human tombs.
orientation: Northeast of the central Amun temple.

claims.text: These galleries contained niches for small Osiris figures rather than human tombs.
The structure used fired brick, plaster and painted decoration. The niches were closed with clay plaques.
The source describes burial of Osiris statuettes in this hypogeum; do not label it a royal necropolis.

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
